curriculum_video_overview.topics_covered: NCERT NCF 2023 / NEP 2020 educational objectives, multilingualism, inclusive learning, and holistic student development pedagogy.

image_asset.title: Ch 1: Swadesh Concept Map & Word Web

hotspots.label: Motherland's Debt
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Civic duty toward the soil that nourishes through food and water.

hotspots.label: True Life vs Stone Heart
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: A heart devoid of patriotism is unfeeling like cold stone.

hotspots.label: Oj Guna & Action
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Poetic vigor calling youth to active national service and self-respect.

video_overview.title: Swadesh: Patriot's Call
video_overview.topics_covered: Gaya Prasad Shukla 'Sanehi's patriotic poem, emotional connection to the homeland, national devotion, and civic duty.

image_asset.title: Ch 2: Do Gauraiya Nesting Dynamics & Coexistence

hotspots.label: Father's Resistance
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Attempts to evict sparrows nesting on the ceiling fan.

hotspots.label: Maternal Affection
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Mother feeding her chicks, melting human hostility into compassion.

hotspots.label: Coexistence Principle
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Humorous domestic depiction of nature intruding into human spaces.

video_overview.title: The Ceiling Fan War
video_overview.topics_covered: Bhisham Sahni's story on domestic sparrow nesting on a ceiling fan, human-wildlife co-existence, and parental shift to compassion.

image_asset.title: Ch 3: Dr. Kalam Goal Setting & Dream Ladder

hotspots.label: True Dreams
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Aspirations that keep you awake and drive continuous action.

hotspots.label: High Ambition
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Setting small targets is a crime against one's own potential.

hotspots.label: FAIL = Learning Attempt
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Reframing failure as First Attempt In Learning.

video_overview.title: The Flight of Dreams
video_overview.topics_covered: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam's philosophy of ambition, goal setting, overcoming failure, and youth empowerment.

image_asset.title: Ch 4: Haridwar Travelogue Map & Ganges Ecology

hotspots.label: Himalayas & Ganges
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Shivalik hills and serene river environment.

hotspots.label: Epistolary Prose
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: 19th-century letter-format travelogue by Bharatendu Harishchandra.

hotspots.label: Rivers as Lokmata
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Cultural and environmental reverence for river ecosystems.

video_overview.title: 1871 Haridwar Journey
video_overview.topics_covered: Bharatendu Harishchandra's 19th-century epistolary travelogue, pilgrimage culture, Shivalik nature, and Ganges ecology.

image_asset.title: Ch 5: Kabir Couplet Ethics & Sadhukkadi Prosody

hotspots.label: Supreme Truth
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Truthful conduct as the highest form of spiritual penance.

hotspots.label: Welcoming Criticism
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Keeping critics close to cleanse one's character without soap or water.

hotspots.label: Gentle Speech
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Renouncing ego to speak sweet, calming words.

video_overview.title: Kabir in the Digital Age
video_overview.topics_covered: Saint Kabir's moral couplets on truth, constructive criticism, ego reduction, gentle speech, and modern digital relevance.

image_asset.title: Ch 6: Moral Power vs Material Wealth Weight Scale

hotspots.label: Landlord's Greed
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Unjust eviction of an orphaned widow to expand a palace garden.

hotspots.label: Basket Burden
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Inability to lift a single basket of stolen earth shatters arrogance.

hotspots.label: Moral Victory
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Sincere remorse leading to the return of the widow's hut.

video_overview.title: A Basket of Soil Analysis
video_overview.topics_covered: Madhavrao Sapre's 1901 landmark story on greed, moral truth overcoming physical power, remorse, and justice.

image_asset.title: Ch 7: Mat Bandho Unconstrained Sky & Freedom

hotspots.label: Unconstrained Flight
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Youthful imagination needing open sky rather than restrictive cages.

hotspots.label: Dangers of Over-Control
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Excessive restriction stifles original thinking and causes fear.

hotspots.label: Creative Freedom
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Nurturing inherent artistic and intellectual potential.

video_overview.title: Unbinding Dreams
video_overview.topics_covered: Mahadevi Verma's defense of imaginative freedom, anti-authoritarian pedagogy, creative expression, and Gillu excerpt.

image_asset.title: Ch 8: Naye Mehman Apartment Layout & Satire

hotspots.label: Urban Hardship
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Cramped rented rooms, summer heat, water scarcity, and sick child.

hotspots.label: Uninvited Guests
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Sudden arrival of strangers causing comedic and domestic strain.

hotspots.label: Hospitality Dilemma
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Conflict between Atithi Devo Bhava tradition and practical urban constraints.

video_overview.title: Naye Mehmaan: An Analysis
video_overview.topics_covered: Uday Shankar Bhatt's satirical one-act play on urban lower-middle-class housing strain, summer heat, and guest etiquette.

image_asset.title: Ch 9: Cosmic Scale vs Human Ego Comparison

hotspots.label: Cosmic Insignificance
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Human physical existence as a tiny dot in the infinite universe.

hotspots.label: Petty Human Ego
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Disproportionate pride, hatred, and artificial boundaries.

hotspots.label: Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Embracing universal brotherhood by understanding our true scale.

video_overview.title: The Ratio of Man
video_overview.topics_covered: Girija Kumar Mathur's philosophical poem contrasting cosmic scale with human ego, hatred, and universal unity.

image_asset.title: Ch 10: Netaji Youth Vision & Freedom Roadmap

hotspots.label: Ideal Nation
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: A free India without class, caste, or gender inequality.

hotspots.label: Youth Commitment
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Disciplined, fearless youth sacrificing personal gain for the nation.

hotspots.label: Contemporary Relevance
hotspots.tooltip_explanation: Addressing modern internal challenges through unity and self-reliance.

video_overview.title: Tarun Ke Swapn
video_overview.topics_covered: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose's historic 1929 address, youth responsibilities, social equality, and self-reliant India.
